purpose: Thumbnail-refresh queue. Target = high-retention + low-CTR videos where the thumbnail is the bottleneck (algo would push harder if CTR rose). Hard-swap cooling/stable videos; Test & Compare accelerating / mid-A/B ones (a hard swap resets a learned CTR signal and can kill momentum).
rule: AVD high + CTR < 3.63% channel avg = thumbnail-capped. Low AVD = retention problem, thumbnail won't fix (skip).
monitor: 7-day window post-change. Hard-swap target: CTR +0.5pt or more. Test & Compare auto-keeps the winner.
stagger_rationale: Dates staggered ~2-3 days apart so each change gets a clean 7-day CTR read against the declining-catalog backdrop (vs 5 swaps at once = unattributable). Order: zero-risk test first (longest runway) -> highest-ROI hard-swap on the no-ship refresh day -> same-instrument Surbahars spaced -> reach-starved gems trail into next week.
